Which refractor am I holding? No price feed answers that, so the real app asks at most four picture questions — print run, surface pattern, colour, then a side‑by‑side — and you confirm. Best per set

The gem rate is a knob, not a fact. PSA's population report renders in the browser, so no population number could be read out of its markup — rather than invent one, the expected‑margin column asks you for it. The “if it gems” number needs no assumption at all: it is real PSA 10 money minus real ungraded money minus your fees. PSA paused its Value tiers in June 2026, so the default is the Regular fee. Set it to 24.99 to see what bulk submission does to the list — most of these cards only pay at bulk. These two numbers are a SETTING, not a fact we assert.

Nothing in this mock‑up calls a paid service, creates an account or leaves this machine. The one feed that is free to call — eBay's Browse API for active asks — needs a developer keyset, and its search pages returned HTTP 403 again today, so no live ask appears anywhere on this screen.
